questions.prompt: What is each interior angle of a regular hexagon?
Which regular polygon can tile a floor on its own?
How many equilateral triangles fit together around one point?
How many lines of symmetry does a regular hexagon have?
questions.explain: A regular n-gon has n lines of symmetry.

questions.prompt: What is the order of rotational symmetry of a square?
questions.explain: It looks the same after turns of 90°, 180°, 270° and 360°.

questions.prompt: A square and two identical regular polygons fit exactly around a point. How many sides do those polygons have?
questions.explain: 90 + 2x = 360, so x = 135°, which is a regular octagon's angle.

questions.prompt: Why do honeybees build hexagonal cells?
options: Hexagons tile with no gaps and hold the most honey for the least wax
Hexagons are the easiest shape to draw
Bees can only count to six
questions.explain: Of the shapes that tile, hexagons enclose the most area for a given perimeter.

questions.prompt: Which capital letter has rotational symmetry but no line of symmetry?
questions.explain: N looks the same after a half-turn but has no mirror line.
